Create a refined dark-surface adaptation of the exact supplied dealer logo. Exact text MUST READ: CAR HAVEN with MANCHESTER below. Keep every name letter exactly, and preserve the supplied monogram/motif and proportions. Exact spelling and business identity are essential.
